sections.heading: Rourkela Steel Plant: India's First Integrated Steelworks, Now Doubling
paragraphs: Rourkela is a steel town before it is anything else. The Rourkela Steel Plant was built with a consortium of West German companies led by Krupp and Demag under a 1953 agreement, with the consortium engaged to design, procure, supervise and commission what Wikipedia records as India's first fully integrated steel plant. A 1956 agreement fixed the initial capacity at 1 million tonnes of raw steel a year, and the plant was inaugurated in February 1959. Today SAIL's Rourkela works makes plate-mill and hot-rolled plates, hot-rolled coils, ERW and spiral-welded pipes and silicon steel sheets and coils.

The next phase is large. A Ministry of Steel reply in the Lok Sabha gives Rourkela's crude steel capacity as 3.80 million tonnes a year, to be raised to 9.70 million tonnes by 2030-31 under SAIL's expansion plan. In March 2025 the plant's director in charge told SteelOrbis that capacity would go from 4.4 million tonnes to 9 million tonnes with an investment of about US$3.45 billion, including a new blast furnace and a new steel melting shop. Whichever baseline is used, Rourkela is about to see a decade of construction, commissioning and new process units.

sections.heading: Where Electropolished Stainless Fits in a Rourkela Steelworks
paragraphs: Almost nothing in a steel plant's main process is stainless, let alone electropolished. The exceptions are the small-bore systems that keep the plant's chemistry and measurements honest. Boiler and power-block steam and water sampling lines, the analyser sample lines on blast-furnace gas, coke-oven gas and the by-product plant, impulse lines to pressure and flow transmitters, and chemical dosing lines for boiler feedwater and cooling-water treatment all rely on a clean, passive, low-roughness bore. A rough or corroding tube adsorbs and releases what it is supposed to be measuring, and the reading lags or drifts.

For these services we supply seamless ASTM A269 instrument tube in 316L, electropolished, and for the acid and chloride-bearing streams of a pickling line, a water treatment plant or a coke-oven by-product unit, 904L, which we supply electropolished. The silicon steel and cold-rolling side adds acid pickling and degreasing lines where 904L dosing and sample tube earns its place. Larger stainless utility runs, such as demineralised water headers, use ASTM A312 pipe in 304L or 316L.

sections.heading: SF1 or SF4 for Rourkela's Water, Gas and Oxygen Lines
paragraphs: Following ASME BPE surface designations, SF1 is a mechanically polished bore and SF4 is mechanically polished and then electropolished. In a steelworks or its captive power plant, SF4 316L belongs on steam-water analysis sample lines, where silica and conductivity readings decide whether a boiler stays on line, on demineralised and ultrapure water lines to the laboratory and to the power block, and on high-purity gas lines in the oxygen plant and the instrument shop. SF1 304L or 316L is adequate for demineralised water transfer, cooling-water dosing headers and general stainless utilities.

The expansion changes the quantities. A new blast furnace, steel melting shop and their power, gas-cleaning and water systems each arrive with an instrument package, an analyser shelter and a water-treatment plant, and the EPC contractors building them order the instrument and sample tube in bulk against a vendor list. That is the enquiry a Rourkela contractor should bring to us early, with the sample-system drawings, so grade and finish are fixed before the panels are built.

sections.heading: Test Certificates for a SAIL or Contractor Vendor File
paragraphs: Public-sector steelworks and their contractors release material against documents, not promises. Each heat we supply carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number, with chemical analysis by a NABL-accredited laboratory, and every length is PMI tested before dispatch, which matters on a construction site where 304L, 316L and 904L lengths are stored together. Each electropolished lot has our internal Ra report, and our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

We supply ASTM A269 and A270 tube, ASTM A249 welded tube and ASTM A312 pipe in 304, 304L, 316 and 316L, with 904L electropolished on request. If your inspection test plan calls for third-party witness, additional tests or a specific marking format, put it in the enquiry so the quotation reflects it.

sections.heading: Sending a Rourkela RFQ
paragraphs: Send a complete enquiry and we quote within 24 hours. For steel plant, power block, oxygen plant or water-treatment work in Rourkela, include:
bullets: The unit and system: steam-water sampling, gas analyser lines, instrument impulse lines, chemical dosing, DM or ultrapure water, or oxygen plant piping, and whether you are the plant, an EPC contractor or an instrument panel builder.
Grade and finish per line: 316L electropolished instrument tube for sample and impulse lines, 904L electropolished for acid and chloride streams, SF1 304L or 316L for stainless utilities.
Tube OD, wall, length and quantity, with the standard: ASTM A269 or A270 tube, A249 welded tube, A312 pipe.
Your inspection test plan or vendor-registration requirements, and the delivery point at the Rourkela site.
